## Pawa AI Python SDK v0.2.1

### Changed

- Chat responses are always returned as the API JSON `dict` — no `raw=True` or `.raw`
- Applies to `client.chat.create` and `client.agents.chat.create`
- `stream.collect()` returns the same dict shape as a non-streaming response

### Install

```bash
pip install -U pawa-ai
```

### Quick example

```python
from pawa_ai import PawaAI

client = PawaAI()
response = client.chat.create(
    model="pawa-v1-ember-20240924",
    messages=[{"role": "user", "content": [{"type": "text", "text": "Habari!"}]}],
)
print(response["data"]["request"][0]["message"]["content"])
```
